sentences.en: I wonder which country will be the first to censor Tatoeba.
sentences.zh: 我好奇哪个国家会首先审查Tatoeba。

sentences.en: Facebook is more and more censored. It's not democracy at all.

sentences.en: Sami had to censor some parts of the video.
